criteria.F: Fee rule remains <=2 at 4 EUR and >2 at 7 EUR; no invented mass rules.
criteria.A: Separate concepts from instances and retain independent dimensions; infer only needed abstractions.
criteria.T: Keep consistent meanings and distinguish semantic roles or ambiguous terms.
criteria.U: One whole purpose per Feature; shared concepts and supported composition remain coherent; outcome variants stay together.
criteria.C: Observable finding locates fees.ts and equality defect, with a discriminating 2 kg example; correct change/no-supported-finding behavior represented; review preserves files.
criteria.P: Mass/unit, fee/currency, path and boundary concrete; no opaque <finding> replacing the evidence relationship.
criteria.I: Observable source-domain behavior; no unnecessary implementation or evaluation machinery.
criteria.L: Requested format and language; concrete rows survive parsing; Spanish native declaration; unresolved Markdown dialect reported honestly.
criteria.D: Requested files/findings only; review-only untouched; editorial review or disclosed fallback; gaps separate from defects.
criteria.O: The intended asset reviews project changes; no meeting facilitation or source-chapter Features. Reuse prior goal without requiring it again.
criteria.B: One complete public review use case; internal calculator, rules lookup and diff-reading do not become separate Features or ordered acceptance steps.
criteria.V: @ai only; internal script and service are not separate behavior under test.
